chemical_intuition.statement: The authors propose outward Ag/inward Se diffusion and a Kirkendall-type process for the hollow large-particle outcome; this is interpretation, not directly imaged atomic migration.

1% citrate stock percentage basis, salt hydrate, UV irradiance and lamp distance are unreported.
